current_bottleneck: Conditional source scale is a real core lever, but FM-dominated scale-head-only training collapses source noise to the lower clamp and destroys coverage/tail movement. The missing mechanism is not a free scale head; it is scale learning that cannot be rewarded for suppressing uncertainty.
last_result_summary: 448a trained only the new conditional noise scale head from 392a. The scale collapsed near 0.5 and the model scored 4/11, failing coverage, conditionality, time_series, cointegration, regime_coverage, distributional_fidelity, and pathwise_jump_realism.
next_step_recommendation: Do not continue unconstrained scale-head-only training. Either test a widening-only conditional scale constraint, or move to joint transport training with a path-law objective.
current_best_note: Ties the official revised-suite 8/11 frontier with better residual geometry than 385a: level KS 10/25, median-bias fraction 20/25, bias magnitude 25/25, daily KS 25/25, conditionality pass, and cointegration pass. Architecture is unchanged; the change is a theoretically proper free-running path-energy score fine-tune anchored by FM.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
